project.name: ImgLab
project.context: Goal-first digital image processing toolkit with optional backend processing.
project.runtimeConstraint: React + Vite + Tailwind CSS + DaisyUI frontend, FastAPI backend for processing.
project.architectureConstraint: Client-side SPA with optional API backend for heavy processing.

assumptions: Frontend uses /api endpoints for processing when backend is available.
UI must avoid grid or glow wallpaper and keep image color judgment intact.
Design contract follows the digital darkroom test-strip bench anchor.
motionPaletteDecision: Motion: test-strip wipe reveal with a physical handle and reduced-motion fade fallback. Palette: graphite bench neutrals with safelight amber primary and cool cyan measurement accents.

conceptualAnchor.name: Digital darkroom test-strip bench
conceptualAnchor.anchorReference: silver-gelatin darkroom test-strip bench with optical enlarger, contact sheet, safelight, and calibration marks
conceptualAnchor.specificReferencePoint: A working bench with a test strip laid over a contact sheet, plus a visible safelight indicator.
conceptualAnchor.rationale: Anchors the UI in a purposeful workflow without using decorative wallpaper patterns.
conceptualAnchor.signatureMotion: A test-strip wipe reveals processed pixels over the original image.
conceptualAnchor.signatureMove: A physical handle sits on the wipe line and can be dragged by the user.
conceptualAnchor.typographicDecision: Compact operation titles, plain body copy, small metadata labels, aligned numeric parameter values.

visualResetStrategy: Replace the previous minimal canvas look with a layered bench composition, contact-sheet goal rail, and test-strip wipe stage while keeping backgrounds clean and non-decorative.

derivedTokenLogic.anchorReference: silver-gelatin darkroom test-strip bench with optical enlarger, contact sheet, safelight, and calibration marks
derivedTokenLogic.colorDerivationSource: Graphite bench surfaces, safelight amber, and cool cyan tool markings.
derivedTokenLogic.spacingDerivationSource: Bench layout with tight tool grouping and clear stage separation.
derivedTokenLogic.typographyDerivationSource: Technical labeling from darkroom gear: compact titles, small metadata, monospaced numbers.
derivedTokenLogic.motionDerivationSource: Manual test-strip wipe and short fades for state changes.
derivedTokenLogic.validationRule: Every token must trace to the bench anchor; no grid or glow wallpaper tokens are allowed.

functionalRoles: safelight amber indicates primary actions and processing readiness
cyan indicates measurement, focus, and wipe handle
colorTruth.nonTransferableBehavior: Safelight amber is intentionally dominant to evoke a darkroom workbench rather than a generic UI palette.

crossViewportAdaptation.mobile: Stage first, goal rail collapses under the image with a single-column list.
crossViewportAdaptation.tablet: Stage and goal rail split into two columns with compact headers.
crossViewportAdaptation.desktop: Stage dominates left; goal rail is a vertical contact sheet on the right.

motionSystem.reducedMotionFallback: Immediate swap or short fade with no wipe animation.

componentMorphology.stage: Layered bench frame with a wipe line and handle.
componentMorphology.goalRail: Compact stacked buttons with intent summary.
componentMorphology.statusPill: Safelight indicator with backend readiness label.
componentMorphology.dropzone: Framed pad with dashed edge and clear action copy.

aiSafeUiAudit.failureDefinition: Fails if grid, line, or glow wallpaper appears or if calibration marks become page background.
aiSafeUiAudit.backgroundPatternRule: No decorative grid, scanlines, or radial glow backgrounds.

productionContentPolicy.rule: Goal copy must describe user intent and match real operations.

accessibilityPolicy.focusVisibility: Visible focus ring on all interactive elements.
accessibilityPolicy.keyboardAccess: Goal list and wipe slider must be keyboard operable.

implementationOrder: Finalize goal rail and status pill
designExecutionHandoff.notes: Keep backgrounds clean and avoid decorative lines or glows.

mustPass: Focus and contrast meet WCAG 2.2 AA
driftSignals: Goal rail looks like a default card list
Calibration marks appear in the background

allowedSources: official React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, DaisyUI docs

libraryDecisions.purpose: Component model for the frontend UI.
libraryDecisions.fallback: Use the existing static HTML build if React tooling fails.

libraryDecisions.purpose: Frontend dev server and build tool.
libraryDecisions.fallback: Use the static server for local-only preview.

libraryDecisions.purpose: Utility styling and token mapping via DaisyUI.
libraryDecisions.fallback: Use scoped CSS for critical layout if Tailwind config fails.

libraryDecisions.purpose: Semantic component styling and theme tokens.
libraryDecisions.fallback: Swap to base Tailwind utility styling.

repoEvidence.designEvidenceSummary: Frontend exists under frontend/ with React + Vite + Tailwind + DaisyUI. Current UI uses goal-first buttons and backend-only processing, but lacks the darkroom test-strip wipe and anchor-driven styling.
